blog.title: Building Responsive Layouts with CSS Grid and Flexbox
blog.description: Master the art of creating flexible, responsive layouts using modern CSS techniques. Learn when to use Grid vs Flexbox and best practices.
blog.author: CodMonks Team
blog.content:
# Grid vs Flexbox
            Use Flexbox for one-dimensional layouts and Grid for two-dimensional structures.

            # Responsive Design Strategy
            Combine media queries with layout utilities to handle multiple screen sizes.

            # Practical Tips
            - Use minmax() for flexible Grid columns.
            - Avoid fixed widths; prefer relative units.
            - Always test layouts on real devices.
